meaning: The ways converge (handoff 2026-10-24 on #143): the quinta via's intelligent governor of nature is the quarta via's maximal being. A composition of verified results with no new premise: one intelligent first mover moved by none governs nature (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUINTA-VIA-ONE-GOVERNOR), something is maximal in being (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUARTA-VIA), and every first mover moved by none is that maximum (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-MAXIME-ENS with AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD). Its open premises are those of the composed results; #196 closes the quinta via's two scope bridges.
